name: c4_08-joystick
note: U-06: a scripted joystick on device 0 (joystick_script.py; caps with Z, R and POV, 8 buttons), launch set c4_08-razor-plasma (the Razor flyer), no keyboard: centre to 99; Y forward 100-199; X left, sweep right, back 200-439; Z (throttle) down and up 440-639; R (rudder) both ways 640-879; hat up, right, down, left 25 frames each from 880; buttons 1-8 for 10 frames each from 1000 (gaps of 10); Y back 1160-1259; centre to 1399. The Razor hits the ground and the outcome alert stalls frame 1040 (discovery razor-1): a pump-keyed Enter answers it and the mission ends; the program stops at frame 1040.
